entries.impact: C2J does not name the invalid-endpoint error, and no InvalidEndpoint* error is declared by every discovered operation, so aws.api#clientEndpointDiscovery has no error.
The alternate bean property name of a member is only available from this marker.

C2J metadata properties with no standard trait (for example globalEndpoint, checksumFormat, resultWrapped, or a targetPrefix that cannot be the service shape name) are only available from this marker, which holds just those properties.
The declared order and duplicates of operation errors. Operation errors are also emitted, so only the order and duplicates are marker-only.
The verbatim method, requestUri and responseCode of an operation with no @http trait (RPC protocols ignore HTTP bindings).

The input_token does not name a member that Smithy accepts for it (missing, wrong target type, a path for an input member, or a required input token). The operation gets no @paginated trait, so no paginator is generated from standard traits.
The declaration order of required members. @required is also emitted, so only the order is marker-only.
The SDK-synthesized shape flag is only available from this marker.
Smithy waiters bound waiting by maxWaitTime, not by attempt count. A waiter generated from standard traits does not get the C2J maxAttempts.
